integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof with a standalone exact-rational finite-instance checker; finite verification is not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic two-phase endpoint holes in the doubling map, width h at least one quarter, Lebesgue initial states; not a result for arbitrary hole schedules, smaller holes, or other initial measures. Mathematical historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Exact escape laws and survivor-set transitions for periodically alternating holes in the doubling map
